items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: Lawrence's cousin Si on drums then... Well he was on drums, he had taken my place.

ctx.x: And this Earl Watkins was playing the more modern stuff.

Yeah, he was playing the modern stuff. So naturally hired him, which didn't make me angry at all because I just had an idea I wasn't going to make it after the first two weeks with him. You know, I just didn't watch this. You're watching this is it. You just working on Back to the Army. Well, George was out there when I started playing with him. Yeah, Lawrence's cousin Si on drums then. Si Frazier?
